story.label: Our Story
story.heading: Born from <personal> experience
paragraphs: At some point everyone has struggled. Decades old friends Sachin, Vedanshu and Kartik have also faced their share of struggles, each one of us embarking on a personal journey to understand what we were going through. All of us witnessed first hand the barriers and gaps in mental healthcare in India and realised that the system is broken.

Conversations with people who had struggled and therapists who had learned mental healthcare is inaccessible, costly, episodic, fragmented and needs to be fixed. We realised mental healthcare needs to stop being treated as a blackbox. The only way forward is by bringing people and technology together while being open and transparent. So we created <iKan>.

items.question: What is iKan and how does it support mental health?
items.answer: iKan is a mental health progressive web app (PWA) that provides access to professional consultants, self-guided programs, mood journaling, and clinically validated assessments — all in one place. Our goal is to make mental wellness accessible, private, and stigma-free.

items.question: Is iKan a replacement for therapy?
items.answer: No. iKan is a complement to professional care, not a replacement. Our Equip programs, mood tracking, and resources are designed to support your wellbeing between sessions or as a first step.

items.question: How is iKan different from other mental health apps?
items.answer: iKan combines self-paced CBT-based programs, professional consultations, mood journaling, and a resource library into a single platform. We follow "Calm Tech" design principles.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Tap "Get Started" on the homepage, enter your name, email, and a secure password. Your account will be confirmed automatically.

items.question: Is iKan free to use?
items.answer: Browsing resources, assessments, and our library is free. Individual Equip programs and professional consultations are paid services.

items.question: Can I use iKan without signing in?
items.answer: Yes. Public pages like Resources, Assessments, Equip listings, and informational content are accessible without an account.

items.question: How do I update my profile information?
items.answer: Navigate to your Account page. You can update your name, phone number, bio, date of birth, gender, location, and emergency contact details.

items.question: How do I change my password or email?
items.answer: Go to Account → Security section. You can change your password by entering your current and new password.

items.question: Can I export or delete my data?
items.answer: Yes. Under Account → Data & Privacy, you can export all your data as a JSON file. You can also permanently delete your account.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, and net banking through our secure Razorpay integration.

items.question: How do I view my payment history?
items.answer: Go to Account → Payment History to see a complete record of your transactions.

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: We offer refunds on a case-by-case basis. Contact our support team within 7 days of purchase.

items.question: How do I book a consultation with a therapist?
items.answer: Navigate to the Consultation page, browse our verified professionals by category, and select a time slot.

items.question: Are the Equip programs self-paced?
items.answer: Yes. Equip programs are structured into daily modules you can complete at your own pace.

items.question: What mental health assessments are available?
items.answer: We offer assessments for anxiety (GAD-7), depression, stress, well-being, and more.

items.question: How does mood journaling work?
items.answer: The Mood Journal lets you log your mood daily with a rating, emotions, energy level, and free-text reflections.

items.question: Is my data private and secure?
items.answer: Your data is treated as highly sensitive. It is sent over an encrypted connection and stored in an access-controlled database, and we never share it with third parties.

items.question: What should I do in a mental health emergency?
items.answer: Call your local emergency services (112) or the iCALL Psychosocial Helpline at 9152987821.

items.question: How are consultants verified?
items.answer: All consultants on iKan are licensed professionals. We verify their credentials and experience before they join.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.subtitle: Your privacy and data security are fundamental to our mission.
privacy-policy.html:
🔒 Your Privacy Matters

At iKan, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our mental health services.

📝 Information We Collect

Personal Information

Information you provide directly, including name, email, and assessment responses when you create an account or use our services.

Usage Information

Automatically collected data about your platform interactions, session duration, and device information to improve our services.

Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand which parts of iKAN people use, so we can improve them. It records the type of screen you opened — for example an assessment screen or a programme day — never which assessment, which result, or which programme. Your answers, scores, journal entries and anything you write are never sent to Google. You can block analytics with your browser's or phone's tracking controls without affecting how iKAN works.

Health Data

Mental health assessment responses and mood tracking data, which receive the highest level of protection.

🎯 How We Use Your Information

  • ✓ Provide personalized mental health support and recommendations
  • ✓ Improve our services and develop new features
  • ✓ Ensure platform security and prevent fraud
  • ✗ We never sell your personal data to third parties

🛡️ Data Security & Protection

Encryption

Your data is sent over an encrypted connection and stored in an encrypted, access-controlled database.

Access Control

Access to production data is restricted to authorised team members.

Ongoing Review

We review our security configuration on an ongoing basis and act on advisories from our infrastructure provider.

Data Minimization

We collect only the data necessary to provide our services effectively.

⚖️ Your Rights

You have full control over your data. You can access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings.

  • • Request a copy of your data
  • • Correct inaccurate information
  • • Delete your account and associated data
  • • Opt out of non-essential communications

📞 Questions? We're Here to Help

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, our privacy team is ready to assist you.

Email: privacy@ikanhealth.in Response within 24 hours
